literal_meaning: আগুনে ইন্ধন বা কাঠকুটো যোগ করা
figurative_meaning_en: to spread agitation or excitement; to incite or escalate a situation
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় বিতর্কে আগুনে ধূনা দেওয়া হয়ে গেল।
সমস্যা আরও বাড়ানোর জন্য তিনি ধূনা দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: His words added fuel to the fire in the argument.
She incited the crowd by pouring more oil on the flames of discontent.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali rural practices of maintaining hearth fires by adding kindling (dhuna), symbolizing escalation in everyday life.
note: The term 'dhuna' refers to dry twigs or fuel used in traditional cooking fires, deeply embedded in agrarian Bengali culture.
